title: North Valley Gymnastics Society

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: At North Valley Gymnastics, we provide a fun and memorable birthday experience for children of all ages. Our NCCP-trained and certified coaches create an exciting, playful atmosphere with gymnastics circuit activities, games and open play, while adults relax and enjoy the fun from the comfort of our mezzanine. After the action-packed gymnastics session, you'll have access to our private party room to continue the celebration. Guests are welcome to bring their own food, birthday cake, and decorations. 11-15 participants: an additional $35. 16-20 participants: an additional $20.00 on top of the $35. services.name: Seniors Gymnastics
services.desc: Recreational gymnastics is the ideal foundation for athletes starting their gymnastics journey. From toddlers to teens, our programs offer a fun and engaging introduction to the world of gymnastics. Whether your child is a beginner or ready for more advanced challenges, we provide a supportive environment where everyone can thrive. Using the CanGym badge system, a nationally recognized curriculum from Gymnastics Canada, we ensure athletes progress at their own pace, mastering skills before moving to the next level. services.name: Trampoline & Tumbling
services.desc: At North Valley Gymnastics, our trampoline and tumbling (T&T) classes are all about high-flying flips, twists, and jumps, offering athletes the opportunity to master exciting acrobatic skills. The T&T program focuses on building strength, flexibility, and coordination, all while enhancing focus, body control, and spatial awareness - skills that benefit athletes in every sport. The CanJump badge program is used to guide athletes through various levels, helping them improve their skills and build confidence.
